relationships.subject: focused ultrasound
relationships.evidence_quote: These preclinical findings suggest FUS may function to temporarily increase BSCB permeability, facilitating drug delivery and providing a similar effect to that seen in the brain.

key_findings: Review of 20 preclinical studies of FUS with microbubbles opening the blood-spinal cord barrier, with damage thresholds linked to peak negative pressure and microbubble dose
FUS neuromodulation improved spasticity and nerve function in rodent models
